promise: Constitutional ban on re-election of any popularly elected office, promised to take effect in 2027
description: The anti-re-election rule was published 1 Apr 2025, but its implementation was postponed from 2027 to 2030.
evidence: Retained from the existing collection; outcome evidence remains to be documented.

review.note: Official April 1 decree confirms anti-reelection provisions apply from 2030 elections. Original January 2023/2027 promise, exact offices and role at announcement remain unestablished; do not describe every elected office as newly covered.

promise: Defeat inflation ('kill inflation', the overriding goal of his first year)
description: Annual inflation fell from 211.4% (2023) and 254.2% (first month) to 117.8% (2024) and ~31.8% by Sept 2025, with monthly inflation at a five-year low of 1.5% (June 2025) — a huge reduction, though inflation was not eliminated.
evidence: Retained from the existing collection; outcome evidence remains to be documented.

review.note: Search returned INDEC technical indexes, not the needed CPI tables or original pledge. Date/deadline conflict ('first year' versus 2027) unresolved. Need monthly-versus-annual series; claimed June 1.5% must not be certified from unrelated construction-price data.

promise: Restore sound public finances / keep the deficit on a path toward the EU's 3% of GDP ceiling
description: The deficit was 5.8% of GDP in 2024 (up from 5.4% in 2023 and at risk of exceeding 6%), public debt reached 116.5% of GDP in 2025, and the 3% target is far out of reach.
evidence: Retained from the existing collection; outcome evidence remains to be documented.

review.note: Current Reuters reporting describes a 2029 deficit target, not 2027. Need original dated promise and explicit postponement to adjudicate abandonment; forecasts cannot alone establish a future deadline missed. Exact debt/deficit vintage and definitions remain unverified.

promise: xAI announced plans to expand Colossus to at least one million GPUs.
description: The December 2024 announcement concerned expansion to at least one million GPUs. The current Memphis project page describes a by-2026 goal; it does not support the record's 2027 deadline.
evidence: Reuters attributes the expansion announcement to the Greater Memphis Chamber.
The primary Memphis page supplies a different target year.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: a plan is not evidence of installed capacity.

review.note: Reuters supports the December 4 expansion announcement but not a 2027 deadline. The current primary Memphis page instead says by 2026, without establishing when that timetable was announced. Do not choose between these by invention; the newer target is relevant contrary evidence. The detailed interim GPU inventories are unverified.

promise: Huang forecast at least $1 trillion in Blackwell and Vera Rubin revenue cumulatively over 2025-2027.
description: At GTC 2026, Huang forecast cumulative revenue through 2027. The figure is an expectation, not booked revenue.
evidence: NVIDIA's March 16 keynote coverage gives the 2025-2027 period.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the forecast horizon remains future.

promise: Make Europe independent from Russian fossil fuels, ending reliance on Russian gas by 2027
description: The European Commission's REPowerEU plan, presented in May 2022 after Russia's invasion of Ukraine, set the goal of ending the EU's dependence on Russian fossil fuels, including a full phase-out of Russian gas, well before 2030 and by 2027 at the latest. The EU cut Russian gas imports by roughly 75% between 2021 and 2025, and in January 2026 adopted legislation banning Russian LNG imports from the start of 2027 and pipeline gas from autumn 2027.
evidence: Russian gas imports cut by about 75% between 2021 and 2025
EU regulation banning Russian LNG from January 2027 and pipeline gas from autumn 2027 approved in January 2026
National phase-out plans were due to the Commission by 1 March 2026
sources: PubAffairs Bruxelles / Council of the EU

review.note: January 26, 2026 adoption and staged gas-import prohibitions supported. LNG and pipeline transition deadlines vary by contract and storage conditions. Exact original May 2022 promise and 75% reduction denominator were not established; pending remains appropriate for future deadline.

promise: Deliver equal prize money for the men's and women's World Cups by 2027
description: At the March 2023 FIFA Congress, Infantino stated the ambition of equal payments for the men's 2026 and women's 2027 World Cups. Women's 2023 prize money was $110 million; FIFA later approved $655 million in prize money for the men's 2026 tournament. Women's 2027 parity remains to be assessed.
evidence: FIFA announced a parity ambition in March 2023; the women's 2027 tournament remains forthcoming.

promise: Expect Optimus orders in three to five years and eventual mass production at a price below $20,000
description: At Tesla's September 2022 AI Day, Musk predicted eventual large-scale Optimus production below $20,000 and expected orders in three to five years. The upper end of that forecast window had not elapsed at this audit.
evidence: No Optimus consumer sales or price announced as of mid-2026
Optimus still demonstrated only in factory-trial footage

review.note: Five-year window had not expired by September 2026, so absence of consumer sales does not justify broken. Source says orders in three-to-five years, not a firm delivery guarantee. Event was US evening; UTC announcement day and exact deadline need event-time confirmation, not automatic December 31.

promise: Open selected sectors and occupations to workers from Timor-Leste from 2027
description: During his visit to Dili, PM Wong announced that Singapore would open selected sectors and occupations to workers from Timor-Leste from 2027. From the second half of 2027, Timor-Leste will be an approved non-traditional source country for Work Permit holders, with construction and marine shipyard among the sectors opened.
evidence: Announced July 2-3, 2026 in Dili alongside PM Xanana Gusmão
Timor-Leste to become approved non-traditional source country from H2 2027

review.note: CNA page opened but subsequent text retrieval failed; ministry search returned unrelated Work Permit service migrations, not this source-country decision. Exact announcement day, H2 effective window and sector list remain insufficiently checked. Do not use unrelated 2027 e-service rollout as corroboration.

promise: Provide at least €70 billion in military support for Ukraine in 2026, with an equivalent level planned for 2027
description: On July 8, 2026, NATO allies pledged EUR70 billion in military equipment, assistance and training for Ukraine during 2026 and at least an equivalent level in 2027. The record's final deadline covers the second year; the first tranche has its own end-2026 horizon.
evidence: Official summit text confirms the two annual commitments; final delivery is not yet due.

promise: Project at least $1 trillion in Blackwell and Vera Rubin demand and purchase orders through 2027
description: At GTC on March 16, 2026, Huang described visibility into at least $1 trillion of Blackwell and Vera Rubin demand and orders through 2027. This is a forecast, not recognized revenue.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: no completed, comparable order-pipeline accounting was located, and the forecast horizon remains open.

promise: Expect Optimus robots probably to be sold to the public by end-2027, subject to reliability and safety
description: Musk gave a conditional public-sale forecast at Davos in January 2026.
evidence: The forecast remains pending; the target year has not arrived.

promise: "The Terafab is bringing cutting-edge manufacturing to America, creating thousands of high-paying jobs in the Lone Star State, and enabling us to produce AI chips at scale for use on Earth and in space."
description: SpaceX and Tesla announced an initial $16.8 billion Terafab investment in Grimes County on August 6, 2026. The announced manufacturing-space figure above 100 million square feet concerns planned full buildout, not existing facilities.
evidence: SpaceX and Tesla confirmed the $16.8 billion phase-1 commitment on August 6, 2026
Local reporting says production at the Grimes County plant is expected to begin in 2027

review.note: Initial investment and full-buildout floor-space plan are supported; do not imply all area exists in phase one. Exact quote, 3,000 jobs and 2027 production start were not established in retrieved sources. A large project announcement is not completion evidence.

promise: Provide Ukraine a 90-billion-euro loan to support its government and military over the next two years
description: The European Council agreed on December 19, 2025 to a EUR 90 billion loan for Ukraine's 2026-2027 needs, financed through EU market borrowing backed by the EU budget.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the Council decision establishes the financing commitment, but the retrieved source does not establish completed disbursement of the full amount.

promise: Commit up to EUR 73.7 million from Horizon Europe to CEPI for 2026-2027
description: The Commission announced the funding commitment during the World Health Assembly to support vaccine research and epidemic preparedness.
evidence: The May 19 announcement specifies a 2026-2027 funding period; full disbursement was not established.

role: Nvidia / OpenAI Ohio data center financing
promise: Provide a financial guarantee for OpenAI's Ohio data center project, planned at up to $250 billion and scaled back to under $120 billion covering only the first phase
description: Reuters reported a contemplated Ohio data-centre guarantee on August 14. NVIDIA's subsequent quarterly filing confirmed August credit-support guarantees with SB Energy covering approximately 4.25 GW of IT load.
evidence: The filing establishes entered guarantees, but not the original asserted announcement date, larger contractual obligation or 2027 deadline.

review.note: August 14 was reporting about negotiations, not a dated public USD 250 billion promise. The later filing confirms August guarantees for about 4.25 GW with SB Energy. No 2027 completion deadline is supported; a smaller discussed guarantee is not proof of partial fulfillment of a binding larger promise.

promise: Strike a $7 billion licensing and investment deal with AI startup Poolside
description: Reporting described a Poolside technology-licensing and investment arrangement, rather than an acquisition. The claimed antitrust motivation and competitive dominance are not established contractual commitments.
evidence: Reported around August 22-24, 2026; $7 billion licensing and investment deal
Deal described as sidestepping acquisition scrutiny; targets DeepSeek/OpenAI

review.note: Reporting distinguishes a USD 6 billion licence from a USD 1 billion equity investment. The exact August 22 agreement date and a contractual completion deadline were not established; investor distribution by end-2027 is not the same as NVIDIA's deadline to strike the deal. Yahoo full text returned 429; do not treat report timestamps as signing dates.

promise: Invest 200 million euros in Greenland under a new EU-Greenland partnership announced in September 2026
description: Von der Leyen announced a EUR 200 million Global Gateway Partnership Package during her September 7, 2026 Nuuk visit, for investment in and with Greenland in 2026 and 2027.
evidence: The Commission's release establishes the amount and two calendar years; it is an investment commitment, not proof of all funds disbursed.

promise: Extend the Yarisi Bizden urban-transformation programme through December 31, 2027
description: Erdogan announced the extension after the September 7, 2026 Cabinet meeting, replacing the planned end-2026 termination.
evidence: Anadolu and TRT report the extension to December 31, 2027; the full period of programme availability remains prospective.

promise: Develop the joint Freyja anti-ballistic missile programme with partner governments and companies
description: Zelenskyy said on September 7 that meetings with partners involved in the joint Freyja programme would take place soon. Ukraine's security council reported an Oslo meeting on implementation on September 9.
evidence: The sources document meetings and development cooperation without a completed-system delivery deadline.

review.note: September 7 statement concerns forthcoming partner meetings, not completion by December 2027. A September 9 Oslo meeting shows activity, not a deployed anti-ballistic capability. No development deadline was established.

sources.name: Ukraine National Security and Defence Council

promise: End the double-track system in senior high schools by the end of 2027.
description: Mahama set a year-end 2027 target for ending the system that alternates student attendance to accommodate limited school capacity.
evidence: The presidency documented the commitment on September 11; Ghana News Agency reported a subsequent reiteration. These sources establish the target, not its fulfillment.

promise: Target commissioning the SDD-UBIDS library complex in 2027.
description: During a university visit, Mahama said he looked forward to commissioning the library complex in 2027. The due date represents the end of that stated target year, not an announced ceremony date.
evidence: The university's account of the September 12 visit records the 2027 target. Completion has not been established.
sources: SDD University of Business and Integrated Development Studies

promise: Aim to invest an additional C$10 billion in Canada by the end of 2027, subject to investment-return objectives.
description: The pension fund set a conditional investment objective, not an unconditional spending guarantee. Investments remain subject to its return requirements.
evidence: The fund's September 11 announcement states the amount, end-2027 horizon and return condition; Canada's summit release subsequently reported the commitment.
